feeds.title: First Time Mom and Dad
feeds.description: Words of Wisdom for New parents. Blog about family, lifestyle, healthy living, budgeting, kid-friendly meals and crafts, tips for new moms, parenting hacks for new dads, DIY, and lots of parenting humor.

feeds.title: Toronto New Mom Blog
feeds.description: Know about motherhood, parenting, and family life, maternity leave, and how to survive a year at home with your newborn baby. Toronto's new mom blog is your one place to get all the information you need about motherhood and family life in Toronto and Canada. Every week we post new content and guides for new moms.

feeds.title: Love Love Love Blog » First Time Mom
feeds.description: In our first-time mom blog archives, you can browse dozens of articles with everything you need to know about pregnancy, baby names, postpartum, and babies. Blogger Jessica is a mom of four and helps first-time moms navigate pregnancy, postpartum, and beyond. Her goal is to provide you with the best tips and tricks for birth, parenting, and other things.

feeds.title: Shiny New Parent Blog
feeds.description: The Shiny New Parent blog is a place for baby and toddler parents to gather and navigate those amazing but challenging early childhood years. We share articles listing tips and practices to support early childhood development & parent wellness.

feeds.title: Rookie Moms
feeds.description: Rookie Moms is a fantastic resource for women from pregnancy to preschool & beyond. Offering tons of amazing activities for moms and babies alike, including tips from real moms who have been there/ done that, ultimate guides to breastfeeding, sleeping, gear & more!

feeds.title: Being Happy Mom
feeds.description: A Mom to help the new moms in making their motherhood journey smooth. Its all about parenting, baby care and health of baby.

feeds.title: The Mom Friend
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Mary. I'm the mama to a little girl and a mom friend to new moms on this awesome (and often overwhelming) journey of motherhood. From pregnancy to best baby product reviews and life & travel with kids, The Mom Friend shares tips and inspiration for modern moms.

feeds.title: New Mummy Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to New Mummy Blog! Hello I'm Lynne a Gloucestershire based stay at home mummy to 3 year old Toddler H and Baby B, born summer 2017. I blog about our life, home, days out, reviews, tips and whatever pops into my head: so expect the funny, the silly and a few toddler tantrums thrown in too. I do love a good list, so they pop up quite often.

feeds.title: Mom Chipper
feeds.description: Welcome to the world of Mom Chipper. A Fervent SAHM blog. Come, be a part of my world and inspire more women to follow their dreams.

feeds.title: First Time Mom and Losing It
feeds.description: My personal blog about the adventures of a first time mom on a long weight loss journey. I will writing about my journey and posting recipes. Writing reviews on products that are helpful for a mommy and a toddler. Also throw in some crafty tutorials. Join me on my journey as I try to lose the weight while juggling the craziness of being a first time mom.

feeds.title: First-Time-Mommy.com Blog
feeds.description: First-time-mommy.com/blog was started by me, the owner, Monica, in 2008 as a way to connect with other mothers & share information I learned along the way as a first-time-mother. I'm providing reviews and giveaways of all the great products I should have known about the first-time around as well as chronicling my adventures in mommyhood & helping other mothers connect with each other.

feeds.title: Life As Mama Bear
feeds.description: My name is Kristie. I am a full-time stay-at-home mom learning the ropes to motherhood. This is a candid lifestyle blog about the adventures of a first time stay at home mom. My background is in Nutrition and Dietetics and I try my best to create a healthy and active lifestyle for my family!

feeds.title: In Season Mom
feeds.description: I am Cynthia, founder of InSeason Mom. My goal is to ease the fear of the first time expectant mom, to dispel misconceptions about giving birth after 35. My aim is to provide emotional support and encouragement for the older mom as she works with her doctor to ensure the best health care possible.

feeds.title: Tunky's Mommy Blog
feeds.description: Experiences and challenges of being a first time mommy.

feeds.title: 4thTrimester Project | New Parent Blogs
feeds.description: Explore and connect with other new parents through their written experiences on their personal channels. The 4th trimester project focuses on the needs and experiences of cisgender women. Their website is designed to provide the latest medical evidence and offer real, honest stories to inform postpartum planning.

feeds.title: Old New Mom
feeds.description: Old New Mom is a Blog for new mothers navigating the novel difficulties of first-time motherhood. Founder Suzy Lofton Bullis shares crucial tips & tricks and parenting insights to ease their experiences and also recommends supplementary foods and other products for moms. Suzy is a Public Administrator and a mom-blogger.

feeds.title: Swaddles n' Bottles
feeds.description: Read valuable tips, ideas, and insights on all things Pregnancy, Baby, Breast feeding, and all things beyond. Swaddles n' Bottles was Launched in October 2016 with the goal of proving new and expectant mothers with information and resources that could make their journey through motherhood as easy and beautiful as possible.

feeds.title: TheBreastFeedingShop Blog
feeds.description: We provide a comprehensive catalog of all of the products and knowledge you need for pregnancy and becoming a new mom. Learn more in our helpful blog. The Breast Feeding Shop is an online store providing a wide range of top-rated breast pumps and accessories Our experts also offer lactation consultation and advice on which pump is best for mothers.

feeds.title: Bert Anderson Blog
feeds.description: As the creator of the lifestyle blog Me Before Mom, Bert supports millennial moms facing the challenges and changes of motherhood. Me Before Mom is an online community that offers support through real-life stories, encouraging advice, & answers to questions about how a woman maintains herself during this self-sacrificial time of parenthood.

feeds.title: Home With Grey
feeds.description: Welcome to Home With Grey, a life and style blog. Read on to get a glimpse into my life as a new mom. I am new to my 30s, new to my neighborhood, but what isn't new is my passion for shopping, cooking, home decor, and snuggling my son and puppies.
